category_title: Preschoolers who throw tantrums during cleanup transitions
minimal_context: Olivia is playing in the dramatic play center of the preschool classroom and needs to clean up her items.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Olivia, playtime is over. It is time to clean up the dramatic play center.

STUDENT: (Continues her dramatic play) No, I am still playing!

TUTOR: You need to put the items away now.

STUDENT: I don't want to clean up!

TUTOR: We have to clean up the toys.

STUDENT: (Drops to the floor sobbing, crying loudly, and screaming)

options.A: Provide a detailed instruction of each specific element involved in cleaning up the items in the dramatic play center.
options.B: Alter the original plans for the transition and incorporate Olivia's dramatic play contributions into the cleanup routine.
options.C: Follow through to make sure she cleans up the items, helping her do it if she does not do it on her own.
options.D: Give her a warning that playtime will be ending and she will need to clean up by providing a visual and/or verbal reminder prompt.
